ios.desc:
Guess the secret word by meaning, not spelling. Type any word and Wick tells you how close it is: icy blue when you’re cold, warming to red-hot as you close in. One fresh word a day, the same for everyone. 100% free, with no ads and no coins.

Guessing runs on your iPhone. The meaning-based scoring works on a plane, on the subway, anywhere with no signal. Your guesses, stats and streaks stay on your phone, and there’s no account to make.

Now in five languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, and German. Switch anytime in Settings, and race players who play in another language.

HOW IT PLAYS
One secret word each day, all on one screen. Type any word and Wick scores it by meaning, not letters. Cold guesses stay icy blue; you heat toward red as you get closer, and the screen warms with you. Every guess also tells you whether you got warmer or colder than your best.

MEET WICK, THE KEEPER
Stuck? Wick is the AI guarding the word. In the same box you guess with, ask him anything: “Is it alive?” or “Bigger than a car?” He answers honestly, remembers what you’ve already asked, and gives every player the same answer to the same question. He has six faces and a personality to match: sly when you’re cold, flustered when you’re close, shocked when you land it. He’ll never just tell you the word. Asking is always free, and you get three free hints every day.

SHARE YOUR SOLVE AS A VIDEO
Finish a round and tap Share replay. Wick hops across a board of your guesses, from your coldest word to the answer, with the questions you asked along the way. It saves to Photos, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Daily replays hide the day’s word and your closest guesses, so you can post the same day without spoiling anyone.

RACE LIVE
Race someone right now. Wick picks a fresh word and pairs you with another player on a shared clock. First to solve wins. Want to race a friend? Send an invite link or a code, and they can join from the app or right in their browser with no download. They can even play in a different language.

Live races have their own soundtrack, and Wick dances to it: a hop on every beat, and a jump and spin when the music drops for the last minute. Turn on Race alerts in Settings and Wick will tell you when someone is waiting to race.

TODAY’S RACE BOARD
Everyone plays the same daily, so every solve is a race. Submit your result and see where you rank against everyone who played today, under a fun auto name like “Violet Otter.”

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
Pick your lang

quotes.text:
Hello HN!

This is the first game I've ever made and I've been hooked on making apps/web apps ever since. At first it was closed-source for the first couple months of its launch, but this week I decided it should be made open-source. My reasoning for this is there are already a lot of games similar to mine that are about guessing a word based on the meaning of the word and narrowing down the secret word; but I added a little twist.

The game, "Wick", allows you to both narrow down the word by either 1. Guessing by meaning of the word like "fruit" is hot if the word is "lemon", or 2. Asking questions like "Is it a type of fruit?" and the Keeper will answer "Yes/No/Not Sure" etc... but will never spoil the answer.

It works by turning words into an embedding, which in simpler terms is a list of numbers that capture how the word is used semantically. Words used in similar ways get similar numbers. It comes from Gemini's embedding API for web/live race mode, but for iOS single player it uses free apple-intelligence on-device for the questions and it uses Apple's built-in English embedding and four small Core ML models for other languages like Spanish, German, Italian, and French.

The closeness of words is based on cosine similarity of two embeddings. The server embeds a vocabulary of 9,850 common words once, sorts them by closeness to the day's secret, and your guess is how close it is to rank 1 (the secret word). Rank 2 would be the closest word to the secret word. The …
